desc: Staged and run 2026-08-02: initramfs-dcuart-hidf.cpio.gz (e9fcd3b3, minimal busybox + CJ-approved a1f4131d blob, nothing auto-opens inputs). RESULT: first input open reaches CMD_SEND_FIRMWARE 0x95, which returns protocol success; the following CMD_RESET_INTERFACE state-0 command 0x40 returns 0xe00002c2 = kIOReturnBadArgument, open fails, and the machine KEEPS RUNNING. This attribution follows directly from the driver's checked call order and command-specific error logger; the earlier claim that 0xe00002c2 rejected the firmware command was wrong. The "HIDF crashes the boot" belief remains REFUTED. magicmouse binds event0 before interface start (motion untested; needs a human finger). SDK/blob skew remains only a candidate for why the accepted upload leaves reset invalid. Doc: done/2026-08-02-t6040-trackpad-HIDF-rejected-not-crash.md
